description: Land Acquisition - Nawammahara, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Amendment to the notices published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. Nos. 1901/10 of 11.02.2015 by Ella D/S Division and 1926/22 of 05.08.2015 by Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including specific land descriptions, boundaries, claimant information, and compensation procedures. It falls under the Land Gazettes category as it focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures and notifications.
